data.title: Valuations for Most Robotics Startups Will Fall By 2030, Says Vinod Khosla
data.description: Vinod Khosla has been one of the most optimistic investors in robotics, predicting the field will have a “ChatGPT moment” in the next two years. But he is also warning that too much investment and lofty valuations in the hottest robotics startups mean a big shake-out is coming.“I would say more ...
